content_sections.heading: SBI Group CISO Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
SBI Group CISO Vacancy 2026 Out
content_sections.text: State Bank of India has announced one vacancy for the post of Group CISO (Chief Information Security Officer) under Specialist Cadre Officer contractual engagement.

content_sections.heading: SBI Group CISO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for SBI Group CISO Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification and experience requirements mentioned in the official notification. Candidates must possess any one of the following qualifications: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Computer Science & Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics, Electronics & Communications Engineering, Cyber Security or equivalent disciplines with minimum 50% marks. Master of Computer Applications (MCA). M.Tech/M.Sc in Computer Science, Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electronics & Communications Engineering, Cyber Security or equivalent disciplines. Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) Certified Chief Information Security Officer (CCISO) Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) Applicants must have 15-20 years of post-qualification experience in Information Technology or Information Security in Banks, Large Corporates, PSUs, Financial Institutions, Financial Services Organizations, or Technology Consulting firms. A minimum of 5 years of experience should be in Information Security, Cyber Security, or Cyber Defence in Banks/FIs at Senior Management Level. The maximum age limit for SBI Group CISO Recruitment 2026 is 57 years as on 31 August 2026.

content_sections.heading: SBI Group CISO Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive Annual CTC up to Rs. 2.50 crore. The CTC will include fixed pay and variable pay in the ratio of 90:10.

content_sections.heading: SBI Group CISO Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for SBI Group CISO Recruitment 2026 consists of the following stages: Shortlisting Interview CTC Negotiation The interview includes interaction and a 10-minute presentation by shortlisted candidates on relevant job profiles, projects undertaken, or milestones achieved.

content_sections.heading: SBI Group CISO Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the SBI careers portal.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for SBI Group CISO Application
content_sections.text: Recent Photograph Signature Resume ID Proof Date of Birth Proof Educational Certificates Experience Certificates PwBD Certificate (if applicable) No Objection Certificate (if applicable)
